## Scope

Describe the vertical slice and the acceptance gate it satisfies.

## Review declaration

- [ ] Scientific formulas, masks, model revisions, or interpretation changed.
- [ ] Model, data, or complete experiment configuration changed.
- [ ] Runtime, forward count, batching, cache, or I/O behavior changed.
- [ ] Tests and the relevant CPU/GPU acceptance gate pass.
- [ ] Generated artifacts, receipts, and provenance were reviewed.
- [ ] No model weights, secrets, absolute runtime paths, executed notebook output, or run/cache files were added.

If a box is not relevant, explain why. Report operational completion separately from scientific acceptance.
